title: Chaos Event Generator & Automated Bro Staff
acceptanceCriteria: ChaosEventController triggers 4 random chaos events: Protein Powder Spill, Dumbbell Drop Crack, Mirror Flex Stand-Off, Influencer Live-Stream.
Protein Powder Spill slows player/guest movement by 50% until mopped.
Dumbbell Drop Crack causes camera shake, cracks floor, and reduces hotel cleanliness rating.
StaffManager manages hireable, upgradable bro workers with BroCoin purchases.
BouncerBro patrols and auto-resolves flex stand-offs and removes enraged guests.
BaristaBro auto-brews and dispenses protein shakes.
SweeperBro auto-navigates to spills and chalk hazards to mop them.
